result.instructions: Tools for Pool Brain, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have open alerts on their pools right now?"; "List the route stop jobs for this week and who is assigned to each route."; "Show all unpaid invoices for the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pool Brain data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run poolbrain_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run poolbrain_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run poolbrain_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. poolbrain_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.
